# UNION OF PROGRESSIVE PEOPLES [bold]NAVAL INFANTRY, 5TH FLEET - PEOPLE'S GARRISON OF {colony}[/bold]
[bold]ORDERS AND NOTICES OF THE GARRISON COMMAND.[/bold] By decision of the Commanding Officer, acting for the Governor-General and the Party, the following notices are binding on all residents of {colony} from the moment of posting. Study them collectively at your work brigade. Questions are welcomed and will be answered by the nearest patrol.
The North Stars have come to {colony} to guard the labour of its people against corporatist sabotage and the bandits who serve it. Where the Union stands, the Union stays.
[color=#F2C230]STATE CHANNEL - CORRESPONDENCE IS REVIEWED BY THE POLITICAL OFFICER[/color]
